archetypes.name: dyn-suppression-parser
archetypes.rationale: Comment-token parsing has several edge cases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new suppression-reason lint's tokenizer and regex handling. Focus on chained comments, bare-family detection, same-line reason validation, and whether plain prose is ignored without missing real suppressions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
